summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WhatsApp click-to-chat integration for Public Catalog (Iteration 156). All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified public catalog quote form, WhatsApp button display, and Performance Dashboard. CRITICAL regression tests confirmed: WhatsApp KPI count does NOT increase when quote requests are submitted, and NO Communications are auto-created.

integration_issues.issue: data-testid='lead-whatsapp-link' and data-testid='lead-interest-items' not found in LeadInboundSection component. The WhatsApp functionality works (wa.me links are present) but uses different component than CRMPage.js

action_items: Consider adding data-testid='lead-whatsapp-link' and data-testid='lead-interest-items' to LeadInboundSection component for consistency with CRMPage.js (LOW priority - functionality works)
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL REGRESSION PASSED: WhatsApp KPI count does NOT increase when quote requests are submitted - verified by submitting 3 quote requests and checking KPI before/after
CRITICAL REGRESSION PASSED: No Communications are auto-created for public_catalog leads - verified by checking lead communications after quote request
Quote request correctly returns {ok, lead_id, whatsapp:{visitor_link, owner_link}} structure
visitor_link correctly uses company.whatsapp or company.phone (wa.me/18095557000)
owner_link correctly uses visitor's phone when provided, null when not provided
Lead created with interest_items[] and whatsapp field pre-filled from visitor phone
Admin notification created with type='catalog_quote_request', priority='high', metadata includes lead_id and owner_wa_link
Performance Dashboard tab working correctly with all KPIs (Calls, Emails, WhatsApp, Meetings, New Leads, Conversions, etc.)
